column4: the toolchain this test needs (cargo with the wasm32-wasip1 target) is not installed on this runner: it builds examples/rust-workflow and runs a real Rust guest, which skips here and runs in Cross-Language E2E, where it is listed as tier 2 in tiers.yaml (cleat#4132).
